name: status
description: Connection state of the Echo memory server and EchoDebug agent, plus the attached target.

name: list_processes
description: List processes running on the local machine (pid, name, path).

name: attach
description: Attach Echo to a process by executable name or pid. Required before any memory tool.

name: detach
description: Detach from the currently attached process.

name: is_alive
description: Check whether the attached process is still running.

name: list_modules
description: List loaded modules (name, base, size) of the attached process.

name: read_memory
description: Read raw bytes. Returns lowercase hex in 'data'. Max 1 MiB.

name: read_memory_batch
description: Read several small ranges in one round trip. Each entry is at most 64 KiB.

name: write_memory
description: Write bytes (lowercase hex, no prefix) to an address in the attached process. Refuses to write into unmapped memory unless force=true; the reply includes the region flags.

name: query_region
description: Describe the memory region that contains an address (base, size, present, writable, executable).

name: disassemble
description: Disassemble x86-64 code at an address. size 0 lets the backend pick the function extent.

name: enumerate_functions
description: Enumerate functions of a module (address, size).

name: signature_scan
description: Scan a module for an IDA-style byte pattern ('48 8B 05 ? ? ? ?').

name: signature_scan_masked
description: Scan a module for a masked byte pattern (hex bytes plus an x/? mask).

name: string_scan
description: Find occurrences of an ASCII string inside a module.

name: resolve_relative
description: Resolve a RIP-relative target: address + inst_size + int32 at (address + offset).

name: rtti_resolve
description: Resolve the MSVC RTTI class name of an object (address of the object, i.e. of its vtable pointer).

name: rtti_resolve_batch
description: Resolve RTTI class names for several objects at once.

name: memory_regions
description: Walk the virtual address space and list regions with protection flags.

name: pointer_chain
description: Follow a pointer chain: addr = *addr + offset per level.

name: value_scan_first
description: Start a Cheat Engine style value scan.

name: value_scan_next
description: Narrow the current value scan.

name: value_scan_results
description: Page through current value scan candidates.

name: value_scan_clear
description: Discard the current value scan state.

name: pointer_scan
description: Find static pointer paths (module+offset -> offsets...) that lead to a target address.

name: emulate
description: Emulate x86-64 code with Unicorn against the attached process memory (never modifies the process). Use 'write' to inject bytes before the run, 'read' to fetch bytes back after it, and 'mem_log' to see which addresses the code reads and writes.

mem_log.description: Log every explicit memory read/write: rip, address, size, access, value before and (writes) after

name: freeze_value
description: Continuously rewrite a value at an address (the agent re-writes it 20 times a second).

name: list_frozen
description: List the addresses the agent is currently freezing.

name: dump_module
description: Dump a module (default main executable) to Echo's scripts/dmp folder.

name: resolve_export
description: Resolve one export of a loaded module (module!name -> address).

name: peb_walk
description: Walk PEB->Ldr->InLoadOrderModuleList in the attached process via a process-backed Unicorn emulator; returns base/entry/size/full name per module.

name: reopen_native_socket
description: Re-open Echo's native memory socket towards the relay (used after a relay restart).

name: watch_add
description: Watch an address: the agent samples it 10x/s and streams watch_event broadcasts when the bytes change. size is 1..16 bytes (default 4).

name: watch_remove
description: Stop watching an address.

name: list_watched
description: List watched addresses with their last sampled bytes.

name: read_typed
description: Read a decoded value: u8..u64, i8..i64, f32, f64 (value + raw hex), string, wstring, bytes (hex; length 1..4096).

name: region_stats
description: Aggregate the target's memory regions by protection: counts and bytes for present/writable/executable, rw vs rx split.

name: ui_pe_info
description: PE headers, sections, data directories, imports, exports, per-section entropy and packer verdict of a module (parsed in the app). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_strings
description: ASCII and UTF-16 strings of a module with their addresses; optional regex filter. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_xrefs_to
description: Code references (call/jmp/jcc/RIP-relative) to an address inside a module. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_xref_index
description: The most-referenced addresses of a module (whole reference graph indexed in one pass). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_crypto_scan
description: Known crypto constant tables (AES, SHA-256, MD5, CRC-32, Blowfish, ChaCha, TEA, Base64…) in a module. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_code_caves
description: Padding runs (0xCC/0x90/0x00) inside executable sections that can hold a stub. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_antidebug_scan
description: Anti-debug checks in a module: INT 2D, VMCALL, PEB/TEB reads, timing checks, detection APIs, debugger window names. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_triage_imports
description: Imports that deserve a second look (memory tampering, injection, anti-analysis), ranked by risk. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_make_signature
description: Build a unique IDA-style signature for the code at an address (wildcards rel32/disp32, grows until unique). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_dotnet_types
description: .NET (ECMA-335) types, methods and fields of a managed module; optional name filter. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_flirt_match
description: Match the FLIRT signature file loaded in the app against a module. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_rtti_classes
description: MSVC RTTI classes of a module with base classes and vftables; optional name filter. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_snapshot_diff
description: Read a memory window, wait delay_ms, read it again and list the bytes that changed. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_cfg
description: Control-flow graph of the function at an address: basic blocks, terminators and taken/fall-through/switch-case edges. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

with_text.description: include the instructions of each block

name: ui_assemble
description: Assemble x86-64 instructions at an address (nop, ret, int3, jmp/call/jcc to an address, push/pop, mov, add/sub/and/or/xor/cmp/test, inc/dec, db). Returns the bytes; does not write them. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_search_code
description: Search the disassembly of a module's executable sections with a regex over the instruction text (e.g. 'cmp .*0x539'). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_jump_table
description: Recover the switch jump table behind an indirect jmp (MSVC rva tables, GCC relative tables, absolute pointer tables). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_functions
description: Function bounds from the module's x64 exception directory (.pdata). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_find_memory
description: Search process memory forward (or backward) from an address for bytes (IDA-style with ??), text, UTF-16 or a typed value. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

mode.description: hex ascii utf16 i8 u8 i16 u16 i32 u32 i64 u64 f32 f64

name: ui_group_scan
description: Group scan: find places where several values sit at fixed offsets, e.g. 'i32:100; +4 f32:1.5; +8 i32:*'. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_inspect
description: Every interpretation of the bytes at an address (ints, floats, pointer, time, strings) in both byte orders, plus the bytes in a copy format (spaced, hex, c, rust, python, escaped, base64, ida). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_yara_scan
description: Run YARA rules (text, hex with wildcards/jumps/alternatives, regex; and/or/not, of-sets, counts, offsets, filesize, uintXX) over a module, every module (module '*'), or a memory range (address + size). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_sig_health
description: Scan every signature in the app's catalog and report which no longer match exactly once. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_flirt_pat
description: Generate IDA FLIRT .pat lines for a module's functions (names from the app's names; relocated operands wildcarded). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_pe_details
description: Rich header (with checksum check), TLS callbacks, relocation summary, debug directory (PDB name, GUID, age, symbol key) and imphash of a module; signature:true also reads the file and checks its Authenticode digest. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_resources
description: Resources of a module: version info, manifest, string tables, dialogs, icon count, resource count. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_load_symbols
description: Fetch the module's PDB from the symbol server (by its CodeView GUID/age), cache it, and name every public symbol and function in the app. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_il
description: CIL disassembly of .NET methods matching a 'Type::Method' substring (or a token). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_user_strings
description: .NET user strings (#US) with the methods that ldstr each one. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_find_oep
description: Emulate a packed module from its entry point and propose original entry points (code the stub wrote, or the jump into another section). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_rebuild_imports
description: Recover the import table of an unpacked module from its live IAT (pointers into other modules' exports). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_batch_decrypt
description: Run a string-decryption routine at every call site in the emulator and return the strings each call wrote. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_binary_diff
description: Diff the live module against an older build (a PE file path on this machine): changed, added and removed functions. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_guess_struct
description: Guess a struct layout from the live bytes at an address (vtable/function/data pointers, strings, vectors, floats, ints); save:true adds it to the app's type catalog. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_export_struct
description: Export a type from the app's catalog as C++, C, IDAPython, Ghidra script, Binary Ninja script or ReClass.NET XML (format: cpp c ida ghidra binja reclass). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.
